firmware_qualified.source: Not stated by any seed source: no firmware range is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). The gate records the range it qualified (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a, §6b.5).

transport.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-m10's interfaces are not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

paper_mm.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Epson, TM-m10 specifications, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/bs/html/m000920/en/chap10_1.html: “The Epson TM-m10 prints 52.5 mm = 420 dots”, in 58 mm mode

dot_width.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Epson, TM-m10 specifications, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/bs/html/m000920/en/chap10_1.html: “The Epson TM-m10 prints 52.5 mm = 420 dots”. A 420-dot device is a new width with its own goldens

raster_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: no raster command is named for the TM-m10 (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

raster_max_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no raster limit is named for the TM-m10 (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

code_pages.source: Not stated by any seed source: no code page is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). Receipts print as raster; code pages serve only the §2.1 text fallback (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2).

auto_cutter.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-m10's cutter is not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

cut_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: an auto-cutter is named at most, never which GS V cut it honours (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). 1.7.4's partial cut is a baseline, not this device's fact (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

cut_feed_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no feed before the cut is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). It is measured on the device: crate::escpos records why no feed is emitted yet (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.5).

status_protocol.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-m10's status and its transport are not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

drawer_port_volts.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-m10's drawer port is not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

drawer_pulse.source: Not stated by any seed source: no pin or timing is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). The pin is the drawer's property and the timings its solenoid's (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5; ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

supports_raster_arabic.source: A qualification result rather than a datasheet fact: nobody has printed the Arabic goldens on this device (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a; milestone 5.8.3).
